ar: وَ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الَّذِيْنَ ارْتَشَفُوْا مِنْ فَيْضِ نُوْرِهِ جَمِيْلَ الْاِرْتِشَافِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Alladhīna ‘rtashafū min fayḍi nūrihī jamīla ‘l-irtishāf.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family those who drank from the flood of his light most beautiful drinks!

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَ سَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ خَيْرِ خَلْقِ اللّٰهِ عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Khayri Khalqi ‘lLāhi `alā ‘l-iṭlāq.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the Best of Creation without exception!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ صَلَاةً تُزِيْلُ بِهَا عَنَّا الْوَهْمَ وَالْنِّفَاقَ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Ṣalātan tuzīlu bi hā `annā ‘l-wahma wa ‘n-nifāq.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family a prayer by which delusion and hypocrisy are removed!
